newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks firm in London, await U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks firm in London, await U.S. data.

text.p: Japanese shares were slightly firmer in London, but investors remained cautious ahead of tomorrow's U.S. employment report for August, traders said.
"I've had very few requests for bids or offers today," said one London broker. "Everyone is waiting for these numbers."
By 1424 GMT, the Nikkei 50 average was up 12.71 points in London to 1,387.12.
In Tokyo, the benchmark Nikkei 225 average rose 177.95 points to 20,379.82.
The U.S. jobs report is expected to weigh heavily on the near-term course of U.S. monetary policy.
U.S. weekly jobless claims were stronger than expected, hinting that tomorrow's August report also will be strong.
